about: w12 if message.seen on a path with no message before it (always false there); the path through the message does not warn

warnings.rule: if message.seen on a path with no message.send or inmail.send before it; it is always false there
warnings.message: if message.seen on a path with no message.send or inmail.send before it; it is always false there
warnings.hint: Send a message on this path before checking whether it was seen.
